description: Machine-checked ledger of every intentional additive change and bugfix between v1.1.0 and v2.0.0. Any A/B differential mismatch not listed here fails compatibility verification.

additive_element_properties.grab-timeout: Added configurable per-frame grab timeout in milliseconds (default 0 = infinite, preserving v1.1.0 behavior, #45).
additive_element_properties.auto-reconnect: Added opt-in automatic camera reconnection on disconnect (default false, preserving v1.1.0 behavior, #7).

additive_element_signals.execute-command: Added GenICam ICommand action signal supporting selector syntax (#58).

additive_plugin_features.pylondeviceprovider: Added metadata-only GstPylonDeviceProvider registered at GST_RANK_NONE so it does not hijack autovideosrc or OpenCV.

meta_block_id_uses_transport_block_id.rationale: v1.1.0 erroneously assigned grab_result_ptr->GetImageNumber() to GstPylonMeta.block_id; v2.0.0 assigns grab_result_ptr->GetBlockID() and falls back to image_number when transport reports UINT64_MAX (e.g. CamEmu).

capture_error_keep_sets_corrupted_flag.rationale: v2.0.0 marks buffers delivered under capture-error=keep with GST_BUFFER_FLAG_CORRUPTED.

gst_inspect_readonly_default.rationale: v2.0.0 gst-inspect-1.0 is read-only by default (full dynamic limit probing is opt-in via GST_PYLON_PROBE_LIMITS=1), so min/max bounds reported in gst-inspect may differ from probed extremes when GST_PYLON_PROBE_LIMITS is unset.

child_enum_additive_entries.rationale: v2.0.0 registers all implemented GenApi::IEnumeration entries in GEnumClass to avoid GLib critical assertions on real cameras; existing v1.1.0 enum entries must remain present with identical integer values and nicks.

lazy_class_init_deferred_introspection.rationale: v2.0.0 skips Pylon runtime init and camera enumeration in class_init during normal pipeline startup; GstChildProxy and cam::/stream:: properties on an instance still resolve transparently.
